c1-6-001.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | gap | The number of applicants ___ fallen sharply this year. (have) |

item.q: The number of applicants ___ fallen sharply this year. (have)
item.why: *The number of* + plural noun takes a singular verb: the number is one thing. *The number of applicants has fallen.*
item.why_lv: *The number of* + daudzskaitlis *prasa* darbības vārdu vienskaitlī: *skaitlis* ir viena *lieta*. *The number of applicants has fallen.*

c1-6-002.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | gap | A number of applicants ___ already withdrawn. (have) |

item.q: A number of applicants ___ already withdrawn. (have)
item.why: *A number of* = several, so the verb is plural: *A number of applicants have withdrawn.*
item.why_lv: *A number of* = vairāki, tāpēc darbības vārds ir daudzskaitlī: *A number of applicants have withdrawn.*

c1-6-003.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | gap | The manager, together with two of her assistants, ___ coming to the meeting. (be) |

item.q: The manager, together with two of her assistants, ___ coming to the meeting. (be)
item.why: The main noun is *the manager*; a phrase with *together with* does not change the verb: *is coming*.
item.why_lv: *Galvenais* lietvārds ir *the manager; izteiciens* ar *together with* darbības vārdu *nemaina*: *is coming*.

c1-6-004.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | gap | Politics ___ never interested me much. (have) |

item.q: Politics ___ never interested me much. (have)
item.why: *politics* ends in *-s* but takes a singular verb: *Politics has never interested me.*
item.why_lv: *politics* beidzas ar *-s*, bet darbības vārds ir vienskaitlī: *Politics has never interested me.*

c1-6-005.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | gap | The criteria for the award ___ changed this year. (have) |

item.q: The criteria for the award ___ changed this year. (have)
item.why: *criteria* is the plural of *criterion*: *The criteria have changed.*
item.why_lv: *criteria* ir *criterion* daudzskaitlis: *The criteria have changed.*

c1-6-006.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | gap | Ten kilometres ___ a long way to walk in this heat. (be) |

item.q: Ten kilometres ___ a long way to walk in this heat. (be)
item.why: An amount seen as one distance takes a singular verb: *Ten kilometres is a long way.*
item.why_lv: Daudzums, ko *uztver* kā vienu attālumu, *prasa vienskaitli*: *Ten kilometres is a long way.*

c1-6-007.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | mcq | Which sentence has a mistake? | Each of the rooms have its own bathroom.

key.correct: Each of the rooms have its own bathroom.
wrong: More than one guest has complained about the noise.
Neither of the answers is correct.
One in four adults has never been abroad.

item.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
item.why: *each of* + plural noun takes a singular verb: *Each of the rooms has its own bathroom* (*its* shows it too).
item.why_lv: *each of* + daudzskaitlis *prasa* darbības vārdu vienskaitlī: *Each of the rooms has its own bathroom* (*to* rāda arī *its*).
item.correct: Each of the rooms have its own bathroom.
wrong: More than one guest has complained about the noise.
Neither of the answers is correct.
One in four adults has never been abroad.

c1-6-008.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | gap | Either the manager or her assistants ___ going to call you back. (be) |

item.q: Either the manager or her assistants ___ going to call you back. (be)
item.why: After *either … or*, the verb agrees with the nearer noun: *her assistants are*.
item.why_lv: Aiz *either* … *or* darbības vārds *saskan* ar tuvāko lietvārdu: *her assistants are*.

c1-6-009.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | gap | Being late for every meeting ___ not going to help your career. (be) |

item.q: Being late for every meeting ___ not going to help your career. (be)
item.why: An *-ing* clause as the subject is singular, even if it contains a plural noun: *Being late for every meeting is…*
item.why_lv: *-ing* palīgteikums kā teikuma priekšmets ir vienskaitlī, arī ja tajā ir daudzskaitlis: *Being late for every meeting is*…

c1-6-010.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | gap | After three days, the jury ___ still arguing among themselves. (be) |

item.q: After three days, the jury ___ still arguing among themselves. (be)
item.why: The jury as separate people (*among themselves*): plural verb, *are arguing*.
item.why_lv: Žūrija kā atsevišķi cilvēki (*among themselves*): darbības vārds daudzskaitlī, *are arguing*.

c1-6-011.gate_key: adv_can | C1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: The next bus is in an hour, so we ___ walk. | might as well

wrong: might as good
might so well
had as well

item.q: Choose the correct option: The next bus is in an hour, so we ___ walk.
item.why: *might / may as well* + base verb = it is the only sensible thing to do: *we might as well walk*.
item.why_lv: *might / may as well* + pamatforma = tas ir vienīgais saprātīgais: *we might as well walk*.
wrong: might as good
might so well
had as well

c1-6-012.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | mcq | Which sentence has a mistake? | The colleague with who I share an office is on holiday.

key.correct: The colleague with who I share an office is on holiday.
wrong: The colleague I share an office with is on holiday.
The person to whom the letter was addressed has moved.
That's the flat that we looked at yesterday.

item.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
item.why: A preposition goes before *whom* or *which*, never before *who* or *that*: *the colleague with whom I share an office* (or *the colleague I share an office with*).
item.why_lv: Prievārds stāv pirms *whom* vai *which*, nekad pirms *who* vai *that*: *the colleague with whom I share an office* (vai *the colleague I share an office with*).
item.correct: The colleague with who I share an office is on holiday.
wrong: The colleague I share an office with is on holiday.
The person to whom the letter was addressed has moved.
That's the flat that we looked at yesterday.

c1-6-013.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | gap | The report shows the extent ___ which prices have risen. |

item.q: The report shows the extent ___ which prices have risen.
item.why: A fixed formal phrase: *the extent to which*.
item.why_lv: Nemainīgs oficiāls *izteiciens*: *the extent to which*.

c1-6-014.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | gap | Nobody explained the basis ___ which the fee was calculated. |

item.q: Nobody explained the basis ___ which the fee was calculated.
item.why: A fixed formal phrase: *the basis on which*.
item.why_lv: Nemainīgs oficiāls *izteiciens*: *the basis on which*.

c1-6-015.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | gap | Write one word in each gap: We received three offers, none ___ ___ was acceptable. |

item.q: Write one word in each gap: We received three offers, none ___ ___ was acceptable.
item.why: A number or quantity + *of which* for things: *none of which*, *most of which*, *both of which*.
item.why_lv: *Skaits* vai daudzums + *of which* lietām: *none of which, most of which, both of which*.

c1-6-016.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | mcq | Which sentence has a mistake? | Your complaint is being looked by our team.

key.correct: Your complaint is being looked by our team.
wrong: He was accused of lying to the police.
The problem has been dealt with.
The plan was objected to by most residents.

item.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
item.why: The preposition of the verb stays in the passive: *Your complaint is being looked into by our team.*
item.why_lv: Darbības vārda prievārds paliek arī ciešamajā kārtā: *Your complaint is being looked into by our team.*
item.correct: Your complaint is being looked by our team.
wrong: He was accused of lying to the police.
The problem has been dealt with.
The plan was objected to by most residents.

c1-6-017.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | gap | I didn't know anyone at the party, so I had nobody to talk ___. |

item.q: I didn't know anyone at the party, so I had nobody to talk ___.
item.why: The preposition stays at the end of the infinitive: *nobody to talk to*.
item.why_lv: Prievārds paliek *nenoteiksmes* beigās: *nobody to talk to*.

c1-6-018.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: The road was closed ___ repairing the bridge. | with a view to

wrong: in order to
so as to
for the purpose to

item.q: Choose the correct option: The road was closed ___ repairing the bridge.
item.why: *with a view to* + *-ing* (*to* here is a preposition): *with a view to repairing the bridge*.
item.why_lv: *with a view to + -ing* (*to te* ir prievārds): *with a view to repairing the bridge*.
wrong: in order to
so as to
for the purpose to

c1-6-019.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | mcq | Which sentence has a mistake? | Despite that it rained, the match went ahead.

key.correct: Despite that it rained, the match went ahead.
wrong: Everything depends on whether she signs.
I'm curious about how the app works.
In spite of the cold, we ate outside.

item.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
item.why: After a preposition, not a bare *that*-clause: *Despite the fact that it rained…* (or *Although it rained…*).
item.why_lv: Aiz prievārda nelieto *tikai that-palīgteikumu*: *Despite the fact that the tickets were cheap*… (vai *Although the tickets were cheap*…).
item.correct: Despite that it rained, the match went ahead.
wrong: Everything depends on whether she signs.
I'm curious about how the app works.
In spite of the cold, we ate outside.

c1-6-020.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | gap | The heavy rain prevented us ___ leaving the house all weekend. |

item.q: The heavy rain prevented us ___ leaving the house all weekend.
item.why: *prevent* + object + *from* + *-ing*: *prevented us from leaving*.
item.why_lv: *prevent* + papildinātājs + *from + -ing*: *prevented us from leaving*.

c1-6-021.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: Nobody ___ the owner has a key to the safe. | other than

wrong: apart
besides of
in place of

item.q: Choose the correct option: Nobody ___ the owner has a key to the safe.
item.why: *other than* = except: *Nobody other than the owner has a key* (also *except*, *but*, *apart from*).
item.why_lv: *other than* = izņemot: *Nobody other than the owner has a key* (arī *except, but, apart from*).
wrong: apart
besides of
in place of

c1-6-022.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | gap | She has a real talent ___ explaining difficult ideas simply. |

item.q: She has a real talent ___ explaining difficult ideas simply.
item.why: *a talent for* + *-ing*: *a talent for explaining*.
item.why_lv: *a talent for + -ing*: *a talent for explaining*.

c1-6-023.gate_key: adv_subj | C1 | gap | I'd rather you ___ me yesterday, before the meeting, not after it. (tell) |

item.q: I'd rather you ___ me yesterday, before the meeting, not after it. (tell)
item.why: Something someone did in the past that you wish were different: *I'd rather you had told me.* *I'd rather you told me* is about now or later.
item.why_lv: Kaut kas, ko kāds izdarīja pagātnē un ko gribētos citādi: *I'd rather you had told me.* *I'd rather you told me* ir par tagadni vai nākotni.
